title: [review] gcp3_trust_models.json keeps withdrawn IID-binding invariant as live conformance data
description: Found during jqh2 (worker5) review convergence. test/vectors/gcp3_trust_models.json:179-194 (binding_invariant_alice/bob) carries rejected-profile ygg_addr addresses with ygg_lower64 == iid, binding_valid: true, and descriptions asserting 'ygg_addr[8:16] == IID' — the exact invariant spec/decisions.jsonl upstream-yggdrasil-addressing withdraws. Consumed as conformance truth by rust/lichen-link/src/trust.rs:534-561 and rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs:2023-2041. Not quarantined, not relabeled. Pre-existing on HEAD; not introduced by the jqh2 diff. Fix: either quarantine the binding-invariant entries under test/vectors/legacy/ or relabel them as rejected-profile reference with a flip-on-migration tripwire.
close_reason: Relabeled gcp3_trust_models.json binding_invariant_alice/bob as rejected-profile reference (option b): added profile:rejected-native-sha512, live_conformance:false, and a flip-on-migration tripwire to each; rewrote their descriptions and the top-level description to state the ygg_addr[8:16]==IID invariant is WITHDRAWN by spec/decisions.jsonl upstream-yggdrasil-addressing and the entries are internal-consistency reference only, NOT addressing conformance oracles. Vector VALUES unchanged (they match current unmigrated lichen-core ygg_addr_from_pubkey, still native profile; value regeneration is i72x.6/osjz scope; consumer-function design is mjm7 scope). Also added a matching QUARANTINE/tripwire comment to rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs binding_invariant tests (the one consumer lacking the annotation lichen-link and Python test_trust.py already had) — comment-only, behavior-neutral. Validation: JSON parses (16 vectors), schema-neutral (same pending oneOf root error, no inventory drift); oracle anchor test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json#upstream_addr_for_key verified present; binding entries consistent with derivation_* entries; Python test_trust.py 64 passed; Rust lichen-gateway binding_invariant 2 passed (fresh CARGO_TARGET_DIR). NOTE: initial 'cargo test' failed with phantom E0004 L2PayloadKind::Sos from STALE shared cargo cache (/home/mark/Cache/cargo-target), NOT a source break — fresh target dir builds clean; filed P3 l20i. 3x codereview: reviewer model timed out within the 120s tool ceiling on 4 delegation attempts; performed correctness/security/edge passes myself per worker step 4 — all PASS, no findings.
